ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a tilted rhombus PQRS, P is at the upper left, S is at the upper right, R is at the lower right, and Q is at the lower left. Point T is located on the upper side PS, and point W is located on the right side SR. The gray shaded region in the figure is the quadrilateral enclosed by Q, T, S, W, and the unshaded parts are the left triangle QPT and the lower-right triangle QRW. Reasoning: Let the area of rhombus PQRS be A. Because T is the midpoint of PS, PT = (1/2)PS. When triangle QPT takes PT as the base, its height to line PS is the same as the height of the rhombus taking PS as the base, so area(QPT) = (1/2)(PT)(h) = (1/2)((1/2)PS)h = A/4. Because W is the midpoint of SR, RW = (1/2)SR. When triangle QRW takes RW as the base, its height to line SR is the same as the height of the rhombus taking SR as the base, so area(QRW) = A/4. Unshaded area = A/4 + A/4 = A/2. The shaded area is the remaining part, also equal to A - A/2 = A/2. So the ratio of the unshaded area to the shaded area is A/2 : A/2 = 1:1.

raw_record.question_text: In the diagram, $PQRS$ is a rhombus. Point $T$ is the midpoint of $PS$ and point $W$ is the midpoint of $SR$. What is the ratio of the unshaded area to the shaded area?

method.method_draft: First read the image: the shaded region is the quadrilateral bounded by Q, T, S, and W, while the unshaded parts inside rhombus PQRS are triangle QPT and triangle QRW. From the text, T is the midpoint of PS and W is the midpoint of SR. Let the area of rhombus PQRS be A. Since PS is a side of the parallelogram/rhombus, triangle QPT has base PT = 1/2 PS and the same altitude to line PS as the rhombus, so its area is A/4. Similarly, triangle QRW has base RW = 1/2 SR and the same altitude to line SR as the rhombus, so its area is A/4. Thus the total unshaded area is A/2, leaving shaded area A/2, so the ratio is 1:1.

推理：设菱形 PQRS 的面积为 A。因为 T 是 PS 的 midpoint，所以 PT = (1/2)PS。三角形 QPT 以 PT 为底时，它到直线 PS 的高与菱形以 PS 为底的高相同，因此 area(QPT) = (1/2)(PT)(h) = (1/2)((1/2)PS)h = A/4。因为 W 是 SR 的 midpoint，所以 RW = (1/2)SR。三角形 QRW 以 RW 为底时，它到直线 SR 的高与菱形以 SR 为底的高相同，因此 area(QRW) = A/4。未阴影面积 = A/4 + A/4 = A/2。阴影面积是剩余部分，也等于 A - A/2 = A/2。所以未阴影面积与阴影面积的比为 A/2 : A/2 = 1:1。
